name: The Medallion of Faith
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.offerRewardText:
You retrieved the medallion! Now I will be able to leave the chapel and perform my duty.

That duty is to kill the beast who helped corrupt me and so many of my brothers and sisters, Baron Rivendare!
narrative.requestItemsText:
The power of this chapel gives me the strength to resist the corruption in my heart. If I leave it, I will become a death knight. But there is a medallion, the medallion of faith, that will give me the strength I need to leave.

Please, adventurer, retrieve the medallion. It is guarded by Malor the Zealous, a crazed member of the Scarlet Brotherhood who resides deep in the Scarlet Bastion in western Stratholme.

chain.subtitle: 2 quests at level 60, 9,950 XP in all.
